name: River Serpent
otherStatistics: Perception +2. Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 12. No languages.
appearance: A giant river snake with a heavy coiling body. Its slate-blue scales and short neck crest are editorial details adapted from the credited river-serpent illustration.

sections.Printed source: James Wyatt with Ashlie Hope, Plane Shift: Amonkhet, first printing, july 2017, page 38.
sections.Reskin: The CR 2 form uses the Giant Constrictor Snake, 2014 Monster Manual p. 324 and Wizards of the Coast System Reference Document 5.1 p. 374. The separate Giant River Serpent uses a different base.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one creature. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning and grapple the target (escape DC 16). The target is restrained until the grapple ends. The serpent cannot constrict another target during that grapple.
sections.At the table: Constrict imposes the grapple and restraint on a hit. The DC applies to escaping the grapple. The serpent’s swim speed affects movement. The base block gives no separate water-breathing or Hold Breath trait.

name: Serpopard
otherStatistics: Perception +3, Stealth +6. Passive Perception 13. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A venomous feline with a long, flexible serpentine body and a sensitive tongue. The credited illustration shows a sinuous neck and a russet and dark-banded coat.

sections.Printed source: James Wyatt with Ashlie Hope, Plane Shift: Amonkhet, first printing, july 2017, page 37.
sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Pounce. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and landing a claw hit on it in the same turn, the creature makes a DC 14 Strength save. On a failure, it falls prone. The trait then permits a bonus-action Bite against the prone target.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing. The target makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison on a failure or half that poison damage on a success.
sections.At the table: Pounce refers to a Claw attack, but the printing supplies only Bite. Use Bite for the runnable printed actions. Resolve Pounce only if the table separately supplies its missing Claw prerequisite. The text describes perching in trees, and the stat block lists only a walking speed.

name: Kavu Predator
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +4, Stealth +5. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 14. Understands Elvish.
appearance: A large arboreal reptilian predator with broad grasping claws and sharp jaws. Dark olive scales and angular brows are art-informed details.

sections.Printed source: James Wyatt with Ashlie Hope, Plane Shift: Dominaria, first printing, july 2018, page 24.
sections.Traits: Pounce. If the kavu moves at least 20 ft. directly toward a creature and hits it with Claw during the same turn, the target makes a DC 14 Strength save. A failure knocks it prone. If the target is prone, the kavu may Bite it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing.
sections.At the table: The Claw attack can trigger Pounce as part of Multiattack. The printed climb speed is 30 ft. The accompanying breeding lore describes arboreal kavu on sheer surfaces, and the stat block supplies no separate Spider Climb trait.

name: Steel Leaf Kavu
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +4. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 14. Understands Elvish.
appearance: A massive ground-dwelling reptilian cavalry mount. Broad jaws, raised brow plates and a thick scaled neck draw on the credited book artwork.

sections.Printed source: James Wyatt with Ashlie Hope, Plane Shift: Dominaria, first printing, july 2018, page 24.
sections.Traits: Raking Charge. If the kavu moves at least 20 ft. directly toward a creature and hits it with Bite on the same turn, the target makes a DC 15 Strength save. A failure knocks it prone. If the target is prone, the kavu may Rend it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one prone creature. On a hit, deal 23 (4d8 + 5) slashing.
sections.At the table: Rend is also a named action against a prone target. Raking Charge grants a bonus-action Rend when its setup succeeds and the target is prone. The written Large size is the block’s size even though the lore mentions especially large mounts.
